h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rajpur Sonarpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rajpur Sonarpur

items.pText: Rajpur Sonarpur sits on the southern edge of the Kolkata metropolitan area, and much of its new housing comes as gated complexes with a shared garden. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these complexes, and for schools and municipal parks in the area. Every piece is built at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away, and sent to you by road.

If your complex is close to handover, the play area is often the last item on the builder's list. Send us the size of the garden, the age group of the children who will use it and a few photos. We reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing that marks the safe play area, so the builder or the residents' committee can approve it on paper first. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India then puts it in.

richText.heading: Low ground and long monsoons in Rajpur Sonarpur

c: Large parts of this area are low-lying, and water can stand on open plots for days during the monsoon, which usually runs from June to September. Before the equipment arrives, check where rainwater collects on your site and keep the play area away from that spot. A raised base with a gentle slope and rubber flooring on top dries much faster than grass or soil.

Choose galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts, which do not rust in damp air. On soft, wet soil, grouting the posts into concrete footings is usually the safer choice. For residents who want to exercise, see our

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Rajpur Sonarpur from Vasai?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture everything at our Vasai factory and send it by road to Rajpur Sonarpur. Installation is done by our own team or by one of our dealers in eastern India.

items.q: Can a housing complex add a play area after residents have moved in?
items.a: Yes. We can plan around existing paths, trees and parking. Share measurements and photos of the open space, and we will suggest equipment that fits, with the safe play area marked on the drawing.

Manufacturing defects, when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry three years. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry one year.
